data.name: Arsin
data.long_meaning: Origin: Arabic, Arsin means rain or mountain. It is derived from the Arabic word 'ars', which means rain. The name also has a connection to the Arabic word 'sirr', meaning secret or mountain. In nature, mountains are a source of strength and courage, just as rain nourishes and sustains life. Therefore, Arsin is a name that embodies both strength and nourishment.
